murccha.basis: Loss of consciousness (murccha) is classically driven by vitiated vata (governing prana/consciousness) obscuring sattva, with pitta contributing the tamo-guna covering; kapha plays a minor role. [CND_VASOVAGAL]

pratishyaya.basis: Coryza/rhinitis (pratishyaya) is a classical kapha disorder of the nasal srotas (shleshma accumulation), with vata contributing the sneeze reflex -- matches this app's own Q_RESP_UPPER nasal-congestion tags. [CND_ALLERGIC_RHINITIS]

ardhavabhedaka.basis: Hemicrania (ardhavabhedaka) is described in Ashtanga Hridaya as vata-kapha in origin, with pitta contributing when throbbing/burning dominates -- matches this app's own Q_HA_SITE unilateral-headache option tag exactly. [CND_MIGRAINE]

parinama shula.basis: 'Digestion-time pain' (parinama shula) is a pitta disorder of agni/annavaha srotas -- burning, gnawing pain, the same pattern as this app's own Q_ABD_CHARACTER 'burning or gnawing' tag. [CND_PEPTIC_ULCER]

pravahika.basis: Dysentery (pravahika) combines pitta (blood, urgency, heat) with vata (colic, tenesmus, straining); a minor kapha component for mucus. [CND_IBD]

vibandha.basis: Constipation (vibandha) is the textbook example of apana vata dysfunction -- matches this app's own Q_BOWELS 'Constipated, straining' tag exactly. [CND_CONSTIPATION]

arsha.basis: Arsha occurs in all dosha subtypes classically (vataja/pittaja/kaphaja/raktaja/sannipataja) -- the mass/growth itself (ankura) is kapha-predominant, the perianal region is vata sthana, and the bleeding subtype is pitta; generic split favouring vata/kapha for the mass. [CND_HAEMORRHOIDS]

mootraghata - vatashthila.basis: The name itself declares vata (vatashthila = 'vata-mass/stone') -- an obstructive vata disorder of the mutravaha srotas, with kapha contributing the mass/enlargement. [CND_BPH]

yuvanapidaka.basis: Youthful eruptions (yuvanapidaka) -- comedones are kapha (accumulation), inflamed lesions are pitta; matches this app's own Q_RASH_LOOK acne-option tag exactly. [CND_ACNE]

asthi shosha.basis: Bone wasting (asthi shosha) is a textbook vata process -- asthi (bone) is a vata-dominant dhatu, and shosha (desiccation/depletion) is the hallmark vata dhatu-kshaya pattern, the same principle behind this app's own Osteoporosis fragility-fracture evidence node. [CND_OSTEOPOROSIS]

parikartika.basis: Cutting/tearing pain on defecation (parikartika) -- matches this app's own Q_BOWELS 'Sharp, tearing pain when I pass a stool' tag exactly, authored for this same condition. [CND_ANAL_FISSURE]

mamsapaka.basis: Local tissue suppuration (mamsapaka) is a pitta-kapha process -- pitta for the inflammatory/suppurative heat, kapha for the swelling and pus -- matches this app's own suppurative-lump option tag. [CND_BALANITIS_PHIMOSIS]

bhagandara.basis: Fistula-in-ano (bhagandara) is classically tridosha but predominantly kapha-pitta in the chronic suppurating tract; vata for the perianal (apana vata) site. [CND_PERIANAL_ABSCESS_FISTULA]

sayyamutratvam.basis: Bed-wetting (sayyamutratvam) combines kapha (childhood life-stage, deep sleep) with vata (apana vata's control over the bladder sphincter). [CND_NOCTURNAL_ENURESIS]

rodanah.basis: Colic (rodanah, literally 'crying') is a vata disorder -- gas and gripping cramping pain in an infant (a kapha life-stage) is the classical picture. [CND_INFANTILE_COLIC]

artava vaishamya.basis: Menstrual irregularity (artava vaishamya) -- artava (the menstrual factor) is governed primarily by vata (apana vata's cyclical control) and pitta (qualitative regulation); a distinct concept from artava kshaya (scanty flow specifically), which is why that similarly-named Cl_Decision_Tree entry was NOT reused here. [CND_PMS]
